title: codebases Learn lesson
description: One lesson, checkpoint or capstone under content/lessons/. Everything except each exercise's `key` (and a reflection's `rubric`) is public and reaches the browser. `uv run python -m ingest learn` splits the two and writes web/lib/learn/course.generated.ts (public) and web/lib/server/learn/keys.generated.ts (server-only). See docs/learn-authoring.md.

slug.description: Stable kebab-case URL slug: the heading without its number. Never change it once published.

code.description: The human ID: L01 to L24, or C1 to C4.

revision.description: Bump when an exercise, its choices or its key change. Progress is kept per revision, so a learner who completed an older one sees 'Review the updated lesson'.

badge.description: A short note beside the duration, such as 'Start here'.

prerequisites.description: Suggested earlier lessons or checkpoints, by slug. A suggestion only: nothing is locked.

prerequisite_note.description: Shown instead of the generated prerequisite line, e.g. 'C1 or equivalent'.

topics.description: Puzzle topics this lesson prepares for; each links to /puzzles?tag=<topic>.

scenario.description: Capstone and checkpoints: the case being investigated.

code_blocks.description: Code shown on the page. A `line` exercise refers to one by id.

blocks.description: Ids from code_blocks shown with the example.

walkthrough.description: The worked explanation. Public: it's a teaching example, not a check, so it isn't called `explanation` like a key's.

next.description: What comes next, or the module review.

transfer.description: Introduces the practice puzzles. Never names a puzzle's answer.

after.description: Shown after the exercises, e.g. checkpoint review advice.

practice.description: Existing puzzles to try next. Recommendations only: never a completion gate or an answer source.

reflection.description: Capstone only: an optional explanation the learner writes for themselves. Never graded or stored.

rubric.description: Private until the learner asks for it.

inline.description: One line of text. `code` spans and **bold** only.

file.description: A label such as route.js. Original teaching code, never a real snapshot.

role.description: `required` exercises decide completion; `practice` ones are for warming up.

label.description: Shown above the prompt, e.g. 'Guided practice', 'Exit check', '1. Branch'.

block.description: kind: line. The code block whose lines are selectable.

candidates.description: kind: sequence. Steps to pick from, in display order.

review.description: The lesson to revisit after a miss.

key.description: PRIVATE. Never reaches the browser except through the check, hint and reveal endpoints.

answer.description: choice: the choice id. line: the 1-based line number. sequence: candidate ids in order.

explanation.description: Shown after a correct answer or a reveal.

hints.description: Revealed one at a time, on request.

feedback.description: Optional: what to say after a particular wrong choice, by choice id.
